dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Aha, an open-air hot spring! Hmm, judging from the amount of steam, I can reasonably infer that the water is perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: When I'm soaking in a hot spring, my inspiration soars like steam rising from the hot water.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I gotta say, this is fantastic. Seems you really know how to live it up.
